text: [Image #5] lmaoooo can we make a real toolbar now this shit is all over the place on top of other shit xD
resolution: Rebuilt the Studio editor toolbar, which had three absolute Rows all pinned to top:12 so they overlapped (scale/player text drawn over the mode buttons, the fps/FRAMES readout over the texture-export buttons). Re-tiered into two non-overlapping strips: tier 1 (top:8) carries info + view toggles (STUDIO status, scale ghost, mirror) on the left and diagnostics (smooth/log/fps + FrameDiagBar) on the right via justify space-between; tier 2 (top:40) carries all the actual tools (selection modes, transform, contextual edit ops, textureize/compile/export) on their own line in one faint unified bar, left-aligned with flexWrap so a dense selection wraps instead of overflowing off-screen or colliding with tier 1. Pure layout — only the container Rows changed, every button's onPress/logic is untouched; the full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed 7e103d5a0. Best judged live (hot-reloadable); happy to tweak spacing/grouping once seen.
